transformations: Selected source admin areas CHN, TWN, HKG and MAC.
Merged Taiwan subregions into one selectable Taiwan province feature; Hong Kong districts into one Hong Kong feature.
Merged source Paracel Islands geometry into Hainan; retained source Macao geometry.
Simplified shared coverage with Shapely coverage_simplify tolerance 0.03 degrees, rounded coordinates to 4 decimals.
Added hand-authored app slugs, shortened Chinese labels and conventional province codes; app slugs are the stable public interface.
limitations: A generalized travel-atlas illustration, not an official standard map, legal boundary reference, navigational map or complete territorial depiction.
Natural Earth states it uses de facto boundaries by default; this processing does not resolve territorial boundary differences.
34 selectable province-level entries do not imply all geographic territory or islands are present.
Source contains Hainan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macao and some offshore islands including Paracel features. Small islands and coastal details may be absent or generalized.
South China Sea inset and any associated maritime boundary representation are not supplied.
No city or district boundary polygons are included. Demo city coordinates are approximate marker locations, not boundary data.
